verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec, and the docs point developers to Postman and cURL for testing. None of it mentions official client SDKs or libraries in any language. The OpenAPI spec is only a developer building block from which a user could generate their own client, so it earns no credit toward official SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
